description: This file contains functions and types for managing IndexedDB snapshots, including validation, dumping, restoring, and file-based persistence with locking mechanisms.

methods.name: isValidIdbIndexSnapshot
methods.description: Validates if a value conforms to the IdbStoreSnapshot index structure.

methods.name: isValidIdbRecordSnapshot
methods.description: Checks if a value is a valid record snapshot with key and value.

methods.name: isValidIdbStoreSnapshot
methods.description: Validates if a value matches the IdbStoreSnapshot structure.

methods.name: isValidIdbDatabaseSnapshot
methods.description: Validates if a value matches the IdbDatabaseSnapshot structure.

methods.name: parseSnapshotPayload
methods.description: Parses JSON string into an array of IdbDatabaseSnapshot objects, validating structure.

methods.name: idbReq
methods.description: Wraps an IDBRequest in a Promise for async handling.

methods.name: dumpIndexedDatabases
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of all IndexedDB databases, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: restoreIndexedDatabases
methods.description: Restores IndexedDB databases from a snapshot.

methods.name: resolveDefaultIdbSnapshotPath
methods.description: Determines default file path for IndexedDB snapshot based on environment variables.

methods.name: restoreIdbFromDisk
methods.description: Restores IndexedDB databases from a snapshot file on disk with locking.

methods.name: persistIdbToDisk
methods.description: Persists current IndexedDB databases to disk as a snapshot with locking.
